audit.environment: RAM-only calls; no CIA, VIC, ROM or SID reads
audit.limitations: Standard audits capture read-only/unused ports in each declared 32-byte window; explicit diagnostic projections may narrow this coverage. No SID reads, internal bus behavior, sound synthesis, interrupt/badline timing, bus-write timestamps, end detection, score equivalence or listening judgment.
audit.entryStateBasis: Controlled PAL raster host: init A=selection-1, X/Y=0, P=$26; play A=$FA, retained X/Y, CMP-equal C/Z set and N clear; bank $36 before each call; callable return words derive from the shared harness JSR labels
